Figure 2:Model architecture ofDreamFree. Training is separated into two stages: (a) In the first stage, a pretrained video diffusion backbone is repurposed as a visual encoder through video generative training with a structured attention mask and distillation of predictive representations from the frozen video diffusion model.
(b) In the second stage, the action readout module and action decoder are trained to predict actions by extracting action-relevant information from the encoder.
